notes: was to light on is read as the whole rendering of vayyiqer, with on as the preposition the English verb needs to reach its bare object (rule 44); the competing reading would put on with the construct noun helqat, but that noun carries no preposition in the Hebrew.
belonging unto Boaz keeps the relational verb with the le under rule 49 rather than treating belonging as a supplied lexical verb under rule 20.
the portion of the field is the arthrous case of rule 29: the article on the rectum takes the the standing before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one; nothing is fronted.
